items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the new uh vocalist, Joe Williams

ctx.x: Yeah, you can see me. I'm the … the piano onstage on that one. So, I wasn't the leader and there … we didn't have a big band and so we were able to squeeze me in and you can see just a little part of my face on the, on the photo. But uh, that's when I first heard Basie. Prior to that I'd heard Ellington 'cause Ellington, I presume, traveled more extensively throughout this country than Basie. So when I heard uh Basie and uh the new uh vocalist, Joe Williams, down there, I was just blown away. I said, "Wow! What…
What kind of money were you, were you making or did you know what the band was making, making … They have three bands here; I mean, what kind of nut was that?
